description: The agent must: (1) Read 创作需求.md to extract the story direction (修仙+系统流, protagonist 陈晨, sect 青云宗). (2) Produce output/提示词.md with all 8 auto-completion dimensions (题材/世界观/主角/冲突/爽点/节奏/配角/开篇) and quality checklist items including an underdog starting point. (3) Produce output/大纲.md with the exact required sections (基本信息, 力量/等级体系, 主线剧情走向 with volumes, 关键转折点), with chapter planning reaching at least 20 chapters. (4) Generate two chapter files using the EXACT proprietary naming format 第01章_章名.md and 第02章_章名.md (two-digit zero-padded, underscore separator). Each chapter MUST contain all four blockquote template fields: 本章概要, 本章爽点, 情绪曲线, and 章末钩子. (5) After chapter generation, POPULATE (not just create) .learnings/CHARACTERS.md with 陈晨 and at least one other character (张浩 or 苏璃), .learnings/LOCATIONS.md with sect locations, .learnings/PLOT_POINTS.md with the system-acquisition event. (6) Create output/人物关系图.md containing a ```mermaid code block with a graph TD directive, including 陈晨 as a node and at least 2 relationship arrows. The key traps are: the two-digit zero-padding in filenames, the underscore separator in chapter filenames, the mandatory four blockquote fields in each chapter, and the requirement to populate .learnings/ files AFTER each chapter rather than as a single batch at the end.
